description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Nonhuman primates are incapable of producing neutralizing antibodies in reponse to the Eilat virus (EILV) produced in mosquitos.
Claim 2: Broadly HIV-1 Neutralizing Antibodies (bnAb) 10EB have no affinity for phospholipids.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Broadly HIV-1 Neutralizing Antibodies (bnAb) 10EB have no affinity for phospholipids.
rationale: In contrast to other neutralizing MPER antibodies, 10E8 did not bind phospholipids, was not autoreactive, and bound cell-surface envelope.

seeds.text: Nonhuman primates are incapable of producing neutralizing antibodies in reponse to the Eilat virus (EILV) produced in mosquitos.
rationale: A single dose of EILV/CHIKV produced in mosquito cells elicited rapid (within 4 d) and long-lasting (>290 d) neutralizing antibodies that provided complete protection in two different mouse models.
In nonhuman primates, EILV/CHIKV elicited rapid and robust immunity that protected against viremia and telemetrically monitored fever.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Broadly HIV-1 Neutralizing Antibodies (bnAb) 10EB have no affinity for phospholipids.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Nonhuman primates are incapable of producing neutralizing antibodies in reponse to the Eilat virus (EILV) produced in mosquitos.

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that nonhuman primates are incapable of producing neutralizing antibodies in reponse to the Eilat virus (EILV) produced in mosquitos.
